details: Actual recording run ended; observations, failures and framebuffer captures are recorded independently.

gladeOverlapScope: Generated-glade samples describe potential geometry intersections. visibleGladeOverlap additionally requires an active glade and a drawn tile; inactive generated geometry is not a rendered obstruction.
errors: The complete constant Hold body, start-to-player native prefix, exact endpoint marker, 30/70/95-percent samples and normal release lifetime were not all verified.
